title: Sleep Onset Latency (ISL)
lesson: Initial sleep latency is the elapsed time from lights out to sleep onset. When report components are already known, the same value can be recovered by subtracting total sleep time and wake after sleep onset from total recording time.
memoryClue: Latency is the wait from lights out until sleep begins.
coachBobNote: Keep initial sleep latency separate from wake after sleep onset: one occurs before sleep begins, the other after sleep has begun.

workedExample.prompt: TRT is 470 minutes, TST is 390 minutes, and WASO is 55 minutes. Find initial sleep latency.

guided.prompt: TRT 480 min, TST 410 min, WASO 50 min. Find sleep onset latency.
guided.hint: Subtract both sleep and WASO from TRT.

commonErrors.message: That is total wake time. Remove WASO to isolate the wake time before sleep onset.

guided.prompt: TRT 450 min, TST 375 min, WASO 45 min. Find sleep onset latency.
guided.success: Correct. Initial sleep latency is 30 minutes.
